description: This file contains functions for creating and configuring Moment.js date objects from various input types, including strings, arrays, objects, and timestamps. It manages locale settings, input validation, and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: Moment
classes.description: Constructor for Moment.js date objects, used internally for creating date instances.

methods.name: createFromConfig
methods.description: Creates a Moment object from a configuration object, handling overflow and DST adjustments.

methods.name: prepareConfig
methods.description: Prepares and normalizes input data into a Moment configuration, handling different input types and formats.

methods.name: configFromInput
methods.description: Processes various input types (string, array, object, timestamp) to set up a date configuration.

methods.name: createLocalOrUTC
methods.description: Creates a local or UTC Moment object based on input parameters and configuration.
